column1: What is the purpose of the role="dialog" ARIA attribute on a modal container?
column2: It informs assistive technologies that the element is an application dialog box with interactive content requiring user attention.

column1: What does the aria-modal="true" attribute communicate to the browser and screen readers?
column2: It announces that the dialog is modal, telling assistive technology to treat background content as inert and unavailable while the dialog is open.

column1: What does aria-labelledby="modal-title" do on an accessible dialog container?
column2: It programmatically binds the accessible name of the dialog to the heading element containing id="modal-title".

column1: What does aria-describedby="modal-desc" do on an accessible dialog container?
column2: It programmatically associates the dialog with its descriptive body paragraph for screen reader announcements.

column1: Why must lastFocusedElement (document.activeElement) be cached before opening a modal?
column2: To enable focus restoration by returning keyboard focus back to the initiating trigger button when the modal is dismissed.

column1: What is keyboard focus trapping in an accessible modal dialog?
column2: A mechanism that constrains Tab and Shift+Tab key navigation strictly within the modal's focusable elements while it remains open.

column1: In a focus trap, what happens when a user presses Tab while focused on the last focusable element?
column2: The event is prevented (event.preventDefault()) and keyboard focus wraps around to the first focusable element inside the modal.

column1: In a focus trap, what happens when a user presses Shift+Tab while focused on the first focusable element?
column2: The event is prevented (event.preventDefault()) and keyboard focus wraps backwards to the last focusable element inside the modal.

column1: Why is checking typeof el.focus === 'function' insufficient for filtering visible focusable elements in the DOM?
column2: Because every HTMLElement prototype inherits the focus method, causing hidden (display: none) elements to pass the filter.

column1: How does the browser determine if an element is currently rendered in the visual layout tree using DOM properties?
column2: By checking whether el.offsetParent !== null, or el.offsetWidth > 0, or el.offsetHeight > 0.

column1: Why should an out-of-bounds focus guard (if (!modal.contains(document.activeElement))) be included in a modal Tab handler?
column2: To immediately re-constrain focus to the first or last modal element if focus ever lands outside the modal container.

column1: What standard keyboard key must dismiss a modal dialog according to WCAG 2.1 AA?
column2: The Escape key (event.key === 'Escape').

column1: What CSS rule on the body element locks background document scrolling when a modal is active?
column2: overflow: hidden; (paired with touch-action: none; for mobile touch devices).

column1: Why can applying overflow: hidden on the body cause a horizontal layout shift (CLS) on desktop browsers?
column2: Because removing the vertical scrollbar changes the viewport width, causing layout text and centered containers to snap rightward.

column1: What modern CSS property prevents layout shift when scrollbars are removed during scroll-locking?
column2: scrollbar-gutter: stable; on the root html element.

column1: What CSS property creates a frosted-glass blur effect on the semi-transparent backdrop behind a modal?
column2: backdrop-filter: blur(8px); (with -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); for WebKit compatibility).

column1: Why are opacity and transform properties preferred for modal entry animations over animating top or height?
column2: Because opacity and transform are handled on the GPU Compositor thread without triggering expensive Layout (Reflow) or Paint cycles.

column1: What CSS media query must be used to disable modal scale/fade animations for motion-sensitive users?
column2: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

column1: Why should close button glyph characters like × be wrapped in ×?
column2: To hide the raw symbol from screen readers, ensuring they only announce the button's explicit aria-label.

column1: What is the effect of setting hidden attribute on a modal container element in HTML5?
column2: The browser applies user-agent default styling display: none !important, removing the element from visual layout and the accessibility tree.

column1: What is the time complexity of centralized event delegation for modal open/close actions?
column2: O(1) memory overhead because a single root listener on document handles all dispatch via event.target.closest('[data-action]').

column1: Why should dataset.projectId be used on modal trigger buttons instead of hardcoding project data in the markup?
column2: It allows the JavaScript controller to look up project data dynamically from the single source of truth (PORTFOLIO_DATA).

column1: What JavaScript method is used to safely encode user inquiry messages into WhatsApp web URLs?
column2: encodeURIComponent(messageText).

column1: What is overscroll-behavior: contain used for in a modal scrollable container (.modal-scroll-wrap)?
column2: It prevents scroll chaining, stopping background document scroll when reaching the top or bottom of the modal content.

column1: What is the difference between role="dialog" and role="alertdialog"?
column2: role="dialog" is for general interactive modals, whereas role="alertdialog" is reserved for urgent interruptions requiring immediate acknowledgment (e.g. error prompts).
